prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one extraordinarily polished high-fidelity iPhone app SCREEN, flat straight-on screen design, portrait approximately 1170 x 2532. This is a visual concept for a private digital wardrobe and personal stylist for Muslim women, first used by a wife with a mixed Western and Pakistani wardrobe. It builds modest outfits ONLY from owned clothes. Clean minimal native iOS design, real large readable UI type, generous yet useful space, accessible dark text. Native status bar at top with 9:41, dark camera island, native safe areas, familiar bottom tab bar with four labeled SF-symbol-like icons Today / Closet / Looks / Stylist, home indicator. Avoid a phone hardware mockup, angled device, poster, marketing landing page, decorative flowers, Islamic ornament, sparkles, gradients, random cards, invented product name or logo, shopping, prices, sale labels, badges, performance claims, watermarks or attribution. Use high-quality photoreal clothing cutouts, fabric details and soft natural contact shadows, not drawings. Common owned outfit in every version: full-length flowing mushroom-taupe open abaya, opaque long ivory tunic, cream wide-leg trousers, dusty mauve hijab, dark chocolate flat shoes. No humans or bodies. Primary task is making today's outfit from these existing pieces. Small trustworthy supporting copy. Earth colors with very restrained flower pink, purple and white. This is a usable operational app screen, not an art poster. Direction C, Rose journal. A personal outfit journal that feels warm, expressive and quietly feminine. Flower white #FBF7F3, warm ink #4B3539, dusty rose #A66F7A as limited surface accent, deep plum #705167 for text and primary controls, warm olive garment colors. Large beautiful understated editorial serif heading "Looks to live in." Top small native title "Your looks", plus create action on right. Supporting text "Good outfits, ready when you are." Horizontal segmented control "Saved", "Collections" with Saved selected. Main central image is one large clean beautiful outfit collage on warm pale blush paper, same five owned garments: taupe abaya, ivory tunic, cream trousers, mauve hijab, brown flats arranged as separated fashion cutouts. A small bookmark symbol at top right of collage. Below image serif title "Soft layers, busy days" plus system-sans subtitle "Work · 5 pieces". Small plum-toned quiet action "Make another like this" with simple refresh icon, a proper tappable control. Under that, a narrow horizontally split preview of two more saved garment-only looks labeled "Coffee & errands" and "An evening out", showing a rose Pakistani kurta set and a simple dark full-length abaya set. Before native tab bar a full-width deep plum button "Build a look". Tab Looks selected in plum. The journal must not feel like social media, there are no follower counts, hearts or likes. Clean actual app UI, restrained serif, no decorative illustrations or flowers.
